subject: Dedicated sizing call: throughput & latency assessment

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-discovery: sizing call for dedicated capacity

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about Novarisk's use cases. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we can size a dedicated pool that meets your latency and throughput needs: 

Recap of requirements (from call)
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~650 tokens/sec (peak bursts to ~1.2k tokens/sec)
- Latency target: p95 <= 180ms for 1k-token responses
- Model family: open-llm-v3 family (approx. 30B)
- Peak concurrency: ~40 concurrent requests during business hours; nightly batch jobs up to 200 concurrent short requests
- Data residency: US-only; audit logs required for compliance

Next step: schedule a 60-minute sizing call (technical deep-dive) with your infra lead so we can:
- Walk through the request profile and tail/lifecycle patterns
- Run through a quick ops checklist (KV cache, batching, quantization tradeoffs)
- Agree on target pooling configuration and fallback policy

Attached is a short dedicated-sizing template that helps capture the precise traffic shape — if you can pre-fill the sections marked in yellow, that will speed the call.

Proposed 60-minute slots (Pacific Time):
- Tue Apr 13 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Apr 14 — 15:00–16:00 PT
- Thu Apr 15 — 13:00–14:00 PT

If none of those work, send a couple of times that do and we’ll adjust. I’m looping Marissa (AE) to help with calendar logistics and Dev (SE) to join the technical portion.

Thanks,

— Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the clear recap. Priya (our infra lead) is cc'd; she'll want to join the deep-dive. A couple quick notes from our side:

- The burst numbers may be conservative; some external integrations can send spikes up to ~2k tokens/sec for short periods (1–3 min) during batch window.
- We run a couple of low-latency endpoints that need strict p95 guarantees; happy to walk through specific routes on the call.

Of the proposed times, Thu Apr 15 13:00 PT looks best for us. If that slot fills, Wed Apr 14 15:00 PT is our backup. Please send a calendar invite and include any pre-read we should review.

Thanks,
